reviews.title: Not worth the extra $3
reviews.comment: This cooler looks a little nicer than the V1 but it's not worth $3 more.  They also discontinued the V1, so now your only option is this more expensive V2.  Wish they would have kept the V1 as an option.  Either lower the price for the V2 or bring back the V1.  Oh, and how about you sell these matching fans in a 3 pack for a reasonable price?  Right now you sell them, but only individually and they're like $13 each.  I can't justify that when the Thermalright's can be bought in a 3 pack for the same price.  It seems like ID-Cooling wants to be a more expensive brand.  They're abandoning their budget customers, who made them what they are.  Not good.
reviews.author: Austin
